answer.explanation: Commit a9f46ca (21:36:35Z) changed the CompressionFunction's OUTPUT_BUCKET in template.yaml from !Ref OutputBucket to the literal 'missing-bucket-lambda-rca'. The live configuration was updated at 21:37:37Z and now has the same value, so the bad value was deployed from the IaC change rather than introduced as drift. From 21:37:53Z the function fails every invocation with NoSuchBucket on s3:PutObject to OUTPUT_BUCKET (410 matching log records in the window). The IAM role and the other functions show no anomaly in the window.
